products.name: Gummi Bears MiniBadge Display Board
products.description: Bring all six Gummi Bears together in one display. This kit includes the display board, all six Gummi Bear minibadges, and the components you need to assemble it.
products.priceNote: Includes 7.25% sales tax. No added card fee.
features: Supports clock and traditional minibadge standards
Includes all assembly components, with the ATtiny microcontroller already soldered on
Lanyard hole for wearing your display
Includes a 3D printed backer to help protect your shirt
All six Gummi Bear minibadges included
products.pickup: Free pickup at SAINTCON. Your total is $30.
products.shipping: Shipping is available after the conference. Buyer pays shipping; contact us to arrange it.
